name: Alexandre Laizet
title: Board Director of Bitcoin Strategy
bio: Alexandre is Board Member and Director of Bitcoin Strategy at Capital B, Europe’s first Bitcoin Treasury Company. Alexandre is a committed Bitcoin maximalist.

name: Hunter Albright
title: Chief Revenue Officer
bio: Hunter is the Chief Revenue Officer of SALT Lending, one of the earliest Bitcoin-backed lending platforms, and co-author of the upcoming book - The Bitcoin Advantage. A systems engineer by training with a Ph.D. in optimization and AI from the University of Virginia, he has held senior leadership roles at global banks include Barclays, HBOS, and MasterCard, founded and advised multiple startups, and worked internationally across Europe and the U.S. Hunter has been active in Bitcoin education through the University of Colorado Blockchain Alliance, IEEE blockchain initiatives, and the CryptoCurrency Certification Consortium (C4), and he frequently speaks at global Bitcoin conferences on innovation in Bitcoin-backed finance and financial sovereignty.

name: Rachel Conlan
title: Chief Marketing Officer
bio: Rachel Conlan, a visionary marketer and entrepreneurial strategist is the driving force behind Binance's global marketing and brand campaigns. As Binance embarks on its ambitious journey to reinforce and broaden its standing as the world's most trusted cryptocurrency brand, Rachel's leadership is instrumental. Before joining Binance, Rachel was a transformative figure at OKX, spearheading brand and marketing initiatives that included the negotiation and launch of high-profile international partnerships with Manchester City F.C., McLaren Racing, and Tribeca Festival. Her strategic insights and knack for partnership creation have left indelible marks on the brand. Rachel's vast experience extends to her tenure at CAA Sports, a leading international sports and entertainment agency, where she held the reins of Global Partnerships. She developed innovative brand partnerships and cultural marketing programs, bridging global brands, rights holders, and talent, adding immense value and contributing to CAA's market influence. As the Global Chief Marketing Officer for Havas, the sixth-largest communications company within the Vivendi conglomerate, Rachel demonstrated exceptional leadership. She was entrusted with enhancing Havas' reputation and revenue, crafting integrated marketing and experiential platforms for Fortune 500 companies that set industry benchmarks. In addition to her role as CMO, Rachel's contributions to Havas spanned various leadership positions. As Managing Director of Havas Luxhub, she led strategic and commercial operations, fostering pioneering strategies for luxury, fashion, and lifestyle companies to engage and retain a new generation of consumers. Her client portfolio boasted iconic brands like LVMH, PUIG, Sotheby's, Net-a-Porter, Netjets, and Kit and Ace. Rachel's strategic prowess was further displayed in her role as Havas' Global Growth Director. She orchestrated a comprehensive global new business development and marketing plan for the network. Notably, Rachel was part of the visionary team behind Havas' 2012 rebrand from Euro RSCG Worldwide, establishing a new standard for Havas Group's transformation. Rachel resides in Abu Dhabi, UAE with her husband and toddler son.

name: Stephan Livera
title: Podcaster / Advisor
bio: Apresenta um dos principais podcasts sobre Bitcoin, focado na economia e na tecnologia do Bitcoin. Investe e atua como conselheiro em startups e empresas de Bitcoin.

name: Yat Siu
title: Co-Founder and Executive Chairman
bio: Yat Siu, Co-Founder and Executive Chairman, Animoca Brands Veteran technology entrepreneur/investor Yat Siu is the co-founder and executive chairman of Animoca Brands, a global leader in Web3, blockchain, gaming, and tokenization with the goal to provide all users with property rights for virtual assets. Yat began his career at Atari Germany, then established Hong Kong Cybercity/Freenation, the first free web page and email provider in Asia. In 1998 he set up Outblaze, an award-winning pioneer of multilingual white label web services. After selling one of its business units to IBM, he pivoted Outblaze to incubate digital entertainment projects. One of those projects is Animoca Brands. Yat has numerous accolades, including Global Leader of Tomorrow at the World Economic Forum, Young Entrepreneur of the Year at the DHL/SCMP Awards, and recognition as one of Cointelegraph's top 100 notable people in blockchain. A classically trained musician, Yat is a member of the advisory board of BAFTA (British Academy of Film and Television Arts) and a director of the Asian Youth Orchestra.

name: Alex Gladstein
title: Chief Strategy Officer
bio: Chief Strategy Officer at the Human Rights Foundation and a prominent advocate for Bitcoin as a tool for human rights. He is widely known for his work connecting Bitcoin with human rights and financial freedom globally. Gladstein is a regular speaker and author on the intersection of technology and civil liberties.

name: Brian Dixon
title: CEO
bio: Brian is the CEO of Off the Chain Capital, which is a Warren Buffet value-style investment firm focused on acquiring blockchain assets at a discount. He is the author of four books covering Bitcoin and advanced technology. He entered the Bitcoin space in 2012 and has traveled the world educating people on the importance of the technology and asset.

name: Daniel Jonsson
title: CEO
bio: Daniel is the CEO of newly launched mgmt Digital Infrastructure Fund, a fund focused on bitcoin mining where energy is low cost, stranded or curtailed and leveraging mining with additional revenue streams such as grid balancing and heat reuse in the Nordics and eventually throughout Europe. A passionate miner since 2017, Daniel has been active in the industry founding and leading companies such as Greenblocks, a bitcoin mining company and Viska Digital Assets, Iceland's first digital asset focused hedge fund. Daniel has been an active angel investor in recent years. As a firm believer in proof of work and doing hard things, Daniel can bench press 150kg and deadlift 221kg.

name: Denny Xing
title: VP of Business Development
bio: Denny is currently the VP of Business Development at Hash House, where he leads business development, sales, and project management, driving growth and operational excellence across immersion and hydro cooling solutions and electrical hardware solutions. Prior to Hash House, Denny held key roles at Novablock, Poolin, and Luxor, where he developed expertise across multiple business verticals, including mining pool, firmware, hosting operations, and equipment financing.

name: Derar Islim
title: Antalpha's COO and CEO of Americas & EMEA
bio: Derar Islim, Ph.D. – Chief Operating Officer, Antalpha Platform Holding Company and CEO, Americas & EMEA Derar Islim, PhD, is a seasoned financial executive with significant experience in the digital asset industry, building and managing premier digital assets financial services and products globally. Islim’s career reflects a blend of academic rigor and practical experience in high-stakes financial environments. Derar’s leadership at Genesis, particularly during its crisis, showcased his ability to navigate complex operational and financial challenges from execution and governance perspectives. Derar formerly held the roles of Interim CEO and COO at Genesis and, prior to that, Head of Risk at Hard Yaka. He has an established track record of leading at the forefront of modern financial markets. Early in his career, he served as a senior trader at Bank of America Merrill Lynch, where he co-managed the Funding Valuation Adjustment (FVA) trading desk and worked on modeling, pricing, and hedging credit structured products. Derar holds a Ph.D. in Financial Mathematics from Florida State University, focusing on financial derivatives and applied partial differential equations. Derar is a recipient of the prestigious Fulbright Scholarship, alongside other academic and professional awards.

name: Eowyn Chen
title: CEO
bio: Session on self-custody, wallet security, and digital identity solutions.

name: Erik LaPaglia
title: Managing Partner
bio: Erik LaPaglia is an angel investor, serial entrepreneur, and advisor with a track record of building and revitalizing companies across technology, real estate, advertising, and finance. As co-founder of Miami NFT Week and a board member of multiple organizations, Erik has been deeply involved in bridging innovation with institutional capital, fostering global partnerships at the intersection of Web3, tokenization, and traditional finance. Known for his ability to identify emerging trends and unlock new growth opportunities, Erik has advised and invested in numerous ventures within the blockchain and real-world asset (RWA) tokenization space. He has shared the stage at premier events such as iConnections, SALT, NFT NYC, Bitcoin Conference, and the Benzinga Tech & Finance Conference, engaging audiences on topics ranging from crypto adoption to proptech and capital markets innovation. With a vast network that spans entrepreneurs, investors, and thought leaders, Erik brings a unique perspective on how technology can reshape industries and create scalable, lasting impact.

name: George Mekhail
title: Managing Director
bio: George Mekhail is the Managing Director of Bitcoin for Corporations at BTC Inc., author of I Am Not Your Bruh, and co-author of Thank God for Bitcoin. A passionate advocate for Bitcoin since 2017, George blends his experience in marketing, financial innovation, and community development to guide companies in thoughtfully integrating Bitcoin into their strategic operations, while also advocating for strong family dynamics at home.

She is an expert on developing the mining ecosystem with vast knowledge of high-performance mining hardware and data center development. She is an advocate for renewable energy integration for green mining.

bio: JP has been studying Bitcoin for 12 years and from 2018, co-founded and hosts Bitcoin Sydney, an educational and social group focused on helping existing Bitcoiners and general public understand and get involved in this burgeoning ecosystem. He also presents talks to other community groups on the necessity of owning Bitcoin. His other topics of interest include Bitcoin Game Theory, Bitcoin as sound money/savings tech, Bitcoin satellite connected nodes (first to run one in Aus), Why Bitcoin is the only blockchain that matters, and Bitcoin history.

name: Khing Oei
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Khing Oei is the Founder and CEO of Treasury, a Netherlands-based Bitcoin treasury company recently launched with the ambition to become Europe’s largest. Backed by investors including Winklevoss Capital and Nakamoto, Treasury has the intention to list via a reverse listing on Euronext Amsterdam.

name: Kingsley Advani
title: CEO
bio: Kingsley Advani is CEO of Allocations, CEO of Allo, Managing Partner of Chainfund Capital and has managed $1BN+ in crypto assets spanning private and public markets across multiple funds since 2013 and structured $2BN+ of private equity transactions. Previously, Kingsley was a Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) investment banker at BNP Paribas in London where he advised on $10bn+ of debt financing transactions. Kingsley was an early / seed investor in a number of crypto unicorns including Ethereum, Solana, Polkadot, Avalanche, Arweave, Oasis, Coinbase and Robinhood. He has invested in multiple digital asset treasury companies including: BNC Network Company (NASDAQ: BNC), Nakamoto (NASDAQ: NAKA), SUI Group Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: SUIG), TON Strategy Company (NASDAQ: TONX), Satsuma Technology PLC (LSE: SATS), ETHZilla Corporation (NASDAQ: ETHZ) and Forward Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORD).

name: Madeline Morning
title: Programming Associate
bio: When I’m not planning conferences, chances are I’m reading a book about bitcoin and drinking a cozy beverage.

name: Mark Artymko
title: President & Co-founder
bio: Mark is the President and co-founder at OCEAN, a leading Bitcoin mining pool focused on decentralization, by empowering miners to reclaim their prominent position in the Bitcoin ecosystem. Mark is a former electrical engineer and utility executive, having spent 2 decades in high voltage power system design and operations in Canada and the USA prior to becoming a full time Bitcoin entrepreneur. Mark is a father of 7 and advocate of Bitcoin as the freedom technology of our lifetime.

name: Marko Tarman
title: Lead Mining Manager
bio: Marko's journey with Bitcoin began in its early days, allowing him to witness the evolution of mining from CPU-based to GPU and ASIC-based setups. Currently serving as the Lead Mining Manager at NiceHash, he has been with NiceHash since 2018​. At NiceHash, he focuses on managing and optimizing cryptocurrency mining products and operations.

name: Matt Cole
title: Chairman & CEO
bio: Matt Cole has served as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Strive since April 2023 and serves as the Chairman of the Board. A long-time Bitcoin investor and advocate, Matt has extensive experience in institutional asset management and fixed income, having spent 15 years at CalPERS in global fixed income, where he oversaw over $70 billion in actively managed Fixed Income assets. Matt joined Strive Asset Management in May 2022 as Head of Investment Office & Global Fixed Income. He was promoted to Chief Investment Officer, Global Head of Fixed Income in February 2023 before also becoming CEO of Strive. As CEO, Matt is focused on delivering innovative Bitcoin solutions and transforming how Americans interact with Bitcoin, making it accessible, practical, and central to their financial futures, while Strive remains committed to empowering investors through its pro-shareholder focused equity ETFs and actively managed Fixed Income ETFs. Matt is a CFA charterholder and holds an MBA from California State University — Sacramento.

name: Maurizio Pedrazzoli
title: Founder
bio: Maurizio is a seasoned Bitcoin enthusiast and host of the long-running podcast Mr M Podcast which has been exploring the world of Bitcoin. With over a decade of experience in the crypto space, Maurizio provides insightful analysis, interviews with industry leaders, and discussions on the latest trends and developments in the blockchain ecosystem. His passion for decentralisation and financial sovereignty continues to drive engaging conversations about the future of digital currencies.

name: Nacho Pauls

bio: Bitcoin advocate. Argentine-born, retired athlete, great at teambuilding, full-time learner and resilient.

name: Niko Jilch

bio: Niko is the founder and CEO of digital media company Binifico. He runs one of the most popular podcasts and YouTube channels on the topic of Bitcoin in the German speaking world: "Was Bitcoin bringt". His popular English newsletter is called "Fix the money". Niko is a sought-after speaker at conferences in Europe and internationally.

name: Obi Nwosu

bio: Obi Nwosu is cofounder and CEO of Fedi and a zealous advocate for Bitcoin mass adoption. He previously founded the Bitcoin exchange Coinfloor, and holds board positions at ₿trust and Gridless Compute.

name: Oliver Maroney
title: Head of Business Development and Partnerships
bio: Oliver Maroney leads Business Development and Partnerships at OpenSea. Based out of Portland, Oregon, Oliver’s previous experience includes managing esports and sports talent, sports reporting and more. At OpenSea, Oliver has forged partnerships with some of the best games in the space and started OpenSea’s gaming initiatives like OpenseaGG, a way for web3 enabled games to showcase their games with educational streams and content

Atua nas áreas de mineração e pesquisa de investimentos e criou o Nakamoto Portfolio, uma estrutura para modelagem do Bitcoin em alocação de ativos. Anteriormente fundou a One Partners e a OpenCo. MBA pela Yale University.

name: Richard Teng

bio: Opening keynote on global strategy, regulatory environment, and ecosystem milestones.

name: Rob Hamilton
title: CEO and Co-Founder
bio: Co-Founder and CEO of AnchorWatch, a company pioneering insured custody solutions for Bitcoin held in multi-signature wallets. Under his leadership, AnchorWatch is building the infrastructure to make Bitcoin custody more secure, transparent, and compliant for institutions. Prior to founding AnchorWatch, Rob was a Senior Managing Consultant and Data Scientist at IBM, where he led machine learning initiatives for Watson Advertising.

name: Roya Mahboob
title: Tech Entrepreneur and CEO
bio: Roya Mahboob is an entrepreneur and Afghanistan’s first female tech CEO, but her impact extends far beyond the sphere of business. Ms. Mahboob has used her success and tech expertise to help educate and empower Afghan women and girls, and she has been an outspoken advocate for their rights. She founded the Digital Citizen Fund (DCF), which aims to increase Afghan women’s technological and financial literacy. She also co-founded and supports the Afghan Girls Robotics Team. Ms. Mahboob has worked to build Innovation/Tech Centers across Afghanistan and has launched an online platform to strengthen the voices of Afghan women and journalists. Ancillary to this, she regularly speaks and writes eloquently about the vital importance of STEAM education and economic opportunity for women and girls as they pertain to human rights. Ms. Mahboob was named to TIME’s 2013 list of 100 Most Influential People and received the 2014 Tribeca Disruptive Innovation Award, The Advancement of Gender Equality through Education Award, Young Leader of World Economic Forum 2015 , Asia Game changer 2019, Doha forum award of 2022, LantosHumanRights awards, the prestigious Presidential Leadership Scholarship and is a founding Leader of The NewNow, a group of rising global leaders tackling global challenges.

name: Saifedean Ammous
title: Author
bio: Saifedean is an economist and the author of the best-selling book, The Bitcoin Standard. as well as The Fiat Standard, The Gold Standard, and Principles of Economics. He teaches economics on his online learning platform saifedean.com and hosts The Bitcoin Standard Podcast.

name: Sam Callahan
title: Director of Bitcoin Strategy & Research
bio: Sam Callahan is Director of Strategy & Research at OranjeBTC, overseeing Bitcoin treasury operations and leading the firm’s research and education. He previously served as Vice President at Battery Finance and Lead Analyst at Swan Bitcoin, and he sits on the advisory boards of MARA Digital Holdings and Cantilever Advisors.

name: Shawn Owen
title: CEO & Co-Founder
bio: Shawn Owen is a pioneering entrepreneur and CEO of SALT, the original bitcoin-backed lender. A Bitcoin advocate since 2011, Shawn believes Bitcoin is the best form of digital property and energy savings. He co-founded SALT to offer innovative Bitcoin-backed loans, raising over $124 million and establishing a leading position in the Bitcoin lending industry. With over 25 years of business experience, he is recognized for his expertise in technology, capital allocation, and fostering growth.

name: Simon Gerovich
title: President
bio: Simon is the President of Metaplanet Inc., a publicly traded company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Metaplanet is undergoing a strategic transformation, leveraging Bitcoin as its principal treasury reserve asset. Metaplanet utilizes excess cash flow and implements accretive corporate governance, including financial management strategies such as debt and equity financing, to further its Bitcoin accumulation. Simon has been an active investor in the digital asset ecosystem since 2014. He started his career at Goldman Sachs in Tokyo as an equity derivatives trader. He was a co-founder and Chairman of Red Planet Hotels, a regional hotel company focused on Asia’s value hotel sector. Prior to founding Red Planet Hotels, Simon served as the Chief Executive Officer of Evolution Capital Public Company Limited, a real estate asset management company listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand. As President of Metaplanet, Simon is responsible for spearheading the company's new Bitcoin investment strategy, guiding its overall direction, raising capital, and managing investor relations. He graduated from Harvard University with an AB in Applied Mathematics. Simon is an active member of YPO, the premier global organization of chief executives.

name: Stafford Masie
title: Executive Chairman & Director of Bitcoin Strategy
bio: Stafford Masie is a pioneering South African technologist, entrepreneur, and futurist with over three decades at the forefront of digital innovation. His career began in the early 1990s as a software developer at South Africa’s largest telecommunications company, followed by technology leadership roles at a major technology integrator. He went on to launch his own startup, later acquired, leading him to the U.S. tech scene in 1997, where he spent seven years immersed in Silicon Valley’s ecosystem of innovation at Novell’s HQ in Utah. Upon returning to South Africa in 2004 as Managing Director of Novell Sub-Saharan Africa, Stafford later established Google’s first presence in the country in 2006, serving as its founding country manager. He later launched thumbzup that invented the Payment Pebble®, a world-first globally adopted fintech innovation backed by Visa Inc. During 2014 he was first exposed to Bitcoin, sparking a lasting fascination up until today where he is known in SA as a Bitcoin maxi. Since then, Stafford has become a leading voice and investor in the African Bitcoin and crypto ecosystem. He has angel-invested in and advised multiple AI and blockchain startups, co-founded BitMach, a Bitcoin mining venture in South Africa, and is currently launching a crypto audit and analysis platform in the United States. He served as Chairman of the Board of Altvest Capital, which has since transformed into Africa’s first Bitcoin treasury company (BTCTC) listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE), where he now holds the position of Executive Chairman and Director of Bitcoin Strategy. In addition to his corporate leadership, Stafford independently advises African regulatory bodies on artificial intelligence and cryptocurrency legislation. He has previously served on the boards of Discovery Bank, ADvTECH, and Chairman WITS University/Telkom Innovation Lab, among others. Widely recognized as a Bitcoin maximalist, Stafford is passionate about “orange-pilling” key stakeholders and advocating for Bitcoin as a transformative force for financial sovereignty across the African continent.

name: Susie Violet Ward
title: CEO & Co-Founder
bio: Bitcoin Journalist with a focus on education, and a financial analyst with a background in accounting, holding a deep interest in bitcoin and the environment. Working as a bitcoin columnist for a business-focused newspaper in London and authoring numerous research articles on the benefits of Bitcoin Mining and its implications for renewable energy's future. Serving as the Director and Head of Mining and Sustainability at Bitcoin Policy UK, committed to exploring and educating about bitcoin's technological innovation and potential environmental impact at the core of these professional pursuits.

name: Tracy Hoyos-Lopez
title: Chief of Staff, Strategic Initiatives
bio: Tracy Ann Hoyos López is a strategic force in the Bitcoin and crypto space, currently serving as Chief of Staff, Strategic Initiatives to Arjun Sethi, CEO of Kraken, one of the world’s leading digital asset platforms. With a background in law and public service, Tracy now operates at the intersection of Bitcoin, crypto, policy, and high-level business strategy. She played a pivotal role in orange-pilling President Donald Trump, directly influencing his embrace of Bitcoin and crypto during the 2024 Presidential campaign. Her leadership helped secure President Trump’s historic appearance at the Bitcoin Conference and led to a record-breaking $25 million fundraising effort in just 1.5 months. Her efforts established Bitcoin and cryptocurrency as core components of the national political conversation in the United States. Tracy’s influence extends across the industry, bridging legal expertise, political acumen, and Bitcoin and crypto advocacy. At Kraken, she leads strategic initiatives that shape the company's positioning in both U.S. and global markets. Her deep understanding of regulatory dynamics, coupled with her commitment to financial freedom and decentralization, has made her a trusted advisor, a movement builder, and a driving force behind Bitcoin and crypto’s most important political and institutional breakthroughs.

name: Tristan Thompson
title: NBA Champion, Co-Founder
bio: Co-Founder, Basketball.fun | , Chief Digital Equity Officer World Mobile Tristan Thompson is a championship-winning athlete, entrepreneur, and emerging voice at the intersection of sports, culture, and Web3. After more than a decade in the NBA, he’s shifted his focus to building the future of digital fan engagement and athlete empowerment through technology. As Co-Founder and Lead Advisor at Basketball.fun (TEASER HERE) , Tristan is reimagining what it means to be a fan. The platform gives people the chance to own NBA moments, make live predictions, and build their fan identity through tokenized player shares and clubs, turning the energy of game night into a participatory, on-chain experience. Built on Somnia’s blockchain, Basketball.fun is fast, gasless, and simple enough for anyone to use. It bridges sports, culture, and community while using stablecoins to make rewards instant, global, and real. Beyond sports innovation, Tristan serves as Chief Advisory Officer at AxonDAO, where he’s helping redefine how people control and monetize their health and bio-data. He’s also partnered with World Mobile, a decentralized project focused on expanding internet access. Tristan’s thought leadership has been featured in Forbes, Yahoo Finance , CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block, and on CNBC Crypto World, The Street, Fox News, Thinking Crypto, and CoinMarketCap Live, where he was the first athlete ever featured. His high-profile interviews, including with Bo Hines, reflect his growing influence across sports, crypto, and technology. He recently spoke at Korea Blockchain Week, where he discussed athlete empowerment and decentralized fandom, and is set to appear next at Binance Blockchain Week and Bitcoin MENA, continuing to champion the conversation around Web3 adoption and digital ownership. Thought leadership Op-Eds penned by Tristan: Newsweek: NBA Champion Tristan Thompson: ‘AI is the Ultimate Teammate’ Entrepreneur: How Building Tech With No Tech Background Taught Me the Most Valuable Skill in Business Cointelegraph: Blockchain is the missing trust layer in sports analytics

name: Tyler Evans
title: CIO
bio: Tyler is a the Chief Investment Officer at Kindly MD ($NAKA). He's the co-founder of BTC Inc., the publisher of Bitcoin Magazine and organizer of Bitcoin 2023. He is the Chief Investment Officer and General Partner at UTXO Management, an asset management firm focused on the Bitcoin ecosystem. Tyler serves on the boards of Metaplanet, the Smarter Web Company and Matador.

name: Wright Wang
title: Sales and Marketing Director
bio: With over two decades of technical expertise, Wright Wang joined MicroBT in 2018 and contributed to the development of two generations of ASICs. Subsequently, he transitioned from R&D to marketing and was promoted to Marketing Director in 2019. Wright possesses a profound understanding of the technical challenges faced by MicroBT’s customers and has successfully collaborated with numerous clients to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. Under his able leadership, MicroBT has garnered recognition as a reputable brand, consistently delivering high-quality WhatsMiner products that are widely acclaimed by global customers. In 2023&2024, he was bestowed with the Outstanding Contribution Award of MicroBT, led the key client project team and won the award for outstanding team.

name: Wyatt O'Rourke
title: Founder & CEO
bio: My style is to blend financial savvy with a passion for Bitcoin and conservative values. I seek to offer my clients and peers with a fresh, informed perspective on wealth management. I am interested in the intersection of behavior, incentives, and markets. My thoughts are inspired by the works of Srinivasan, Booth, Alden and many more. My values stem from my Christian faith. My hobbies, marriage, and involvement in communities keep me inspired. To stay active, I enjoy skiing, golfing, camping and hunting. #1 YIMBY and urbanist. Founding member and Chief Marketing officer of the Space. Founder of Basilic Financial, a Bitcoin Wealth Management Firm.

name: Aaron Daniel
title: Co-founder
bio: Cofounder of Resolvr, an insurtech bridging the global insurance market to Bitcoin. Published author for Bitcoin Magazine and the Satoshi Papers.

name: Aaron van Wirdum
bio: Aaron van Wirdum is the technical editor for Bitcoin Magazine and the cohost of the Bitcoin, Explained podcast. With a background in studying the historical influence of society-shaping technologies, he’s been covering Bitcoin and related projects since 2013. He is known for his ability to explain highly-technical subjects to a layman audience and specializes in topics including Bitcoin’s history, scaling and privacy technology.

name: Aarti Carl
title: VP of HR
bio: Aarti Carl is Vice President of Human Resources at Eeze, with over 18 years of experience spanning the land based casino, online gaming and iGaming sectors. A seasoned HR leader, Aarti has built and led high performing, cross functional teams across multiple global jurisdictions, helping organisations scale whilst maintaining strong, people first cultures in highly regulated and competitive environments. At Eeze, Aarti leads HR strategy across multiple regions, partnering with executive leadership to foster inclusive, high impact workplaces that support both operational excellence and long term growth.

name: Abderrahman Ghiadi
title: Head of Mining Pool (MENA)
bio: 10+ years' background in Investments / Bitcoin mining for HNWIs & Institutions. He is also conducting research as a PhD researcher in Economics focusing on Bitcoin, Bitcoin mining, and Energy Economics using stranded or curtailed energy sources, and the development of competitive mining pool services for medium-size to large miners in the MEA region

name: Abdulla Al Dhaheri
title: CEO
bio: Abdulla Al Dhaheri is the CEO of The Blockchain Center Abu Dhabi, leading the UAE’s flagship hub for digital asset innovation. He has played an instrumental role in bringing tier-1 global exchanges and market makers to Abu Dhabi, collaborating closely with regulators and sovereign stakeholders to build the UAE’s leadership in digital assets, AI, and tokenized finance. Abdulla previously advised multi-billion-dollar companies on public listings and digital asset adoption, and has been invited to speak at global conferences for his contributions to decentralized technologies. Today, he continues to invest strategically through The Blockchain Center Fund, scaling global digital asset ventures and sovereign-grade digital asset infrastructures from Abu Dhabi to the world.

name: Abdumalik Mirakhmedov
title: Executive President
bio: Abdumalik Mirakhmedov is Executive President of GDA, one of the world’s largest and most experienced Bitcoin mining companies, with a track record of building, managing, and scaling data center operations spanning nearly a decade. GDA champions innovation, responsible energy use, and investment in the communities where it operates globally, including 20 data centres across North America, South America, Europe, and Central Asia. With a total power capacity of over 600 MW, the company has brought over 180,000 miners online. GDA is committed to supporting the infrastructure for the future of money by making the bitcoin network more robust, resilient, and secure.

name: Abu Akkuc
title: Founder & Creative Director
bio: Abu Akkuc is the founder and Creative Director of 21Million Fashion (Bitcoin fashion brand). With his brand, he demonstrates that Bitcoin is far more than a financial instrument – it is a cultural movement that inspires a new way of thinking. His collections carry the spirit of “Proof of Work”: discipline, perseverance, and authenticity are reflected in every detail. For him, fashion becomes a medium that makes freedom, independence, and creativity tangible. Under the umbrella of 21Million Fashion, Abu has also created a high-fashion subbrand, Orange Elite, which combines the highest quality standards with elegance and the rebellious energy of Bitcoin. Beyond his role as an entrepreneur, Abu is deeply committed to promoting Bitcoin education. He conveys the cultural, social, and philosophical dimensions of Bitcoin, making it clear that it’s not just about money, but about a new understanding of responsibility and self-determination. His work blends style with substance, showing how Bitcoin is shaping our culture and mindset in lasting ways.

name: Adam Calleja Urry
title: Business Development Director – Malta
bio: Adam Calleja Urry is a highly accomplished commercial professional with over 15 years of experience in sales and business development. His expertise lies in scaling B2B revenue streams and building high-performing sales and account management teams. He has a proven track record of managing P&L, developing effective go-to-market strategies, and expanding into key markets across EMEA, Latin America, and Asia. He is currently the Business Development Director for Malta at BetConstruct.

name: Adam Haynes
title: Founder & CEO
bio: Founder & CEO of Simple Mining. We sell, host, and repair Bitcoin miners with the goal of making Bitcoin mining simple, accessible, and profitable for everyone.

name: Adam Mateja
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Adam Mateja is CEO and Co-founder of Blurify, a company specialising in building secure and reliable tech products with a strong focus on the iGaming industry. With over a decade of experience in IT and a track record of delivering more than 100 successful projects, Adam has extensive expertise in strategic advisory roles maximising client success. His specialisation lies in providing tailored software solutions for casino operators, sportsbook providers and game developers, ensuring seamless user experiences and efficient business operations.

bio: Ahmed Bin Sulayem is the Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of DMCC and has driven its growth from a start-up of 28 member companies in 2003 to the world’s leading international business district in 2025 with over 25,000 member companies from 180 countries, employing over 80,000 people. Tasked with enhancing commodity trade flows through Dubai, DMCC has introduced to the market a number of value-added products and services under Mr Bin Sulayem’s leadership. In 2023, DMCC was named ‘Global Free Zone of the Year’ by The Financial Times fDi Magazine, for a record ninth consecutive year. Mr Bin Sulayem oversaw the exponential growth of the DMCC Free Zone master development in Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT), a 200-hectare business and residential community in Dubai of over 100,000 people living and working in 87 towers. Mr Bin Sulayem also oversees the development of DMCC’s latest real estate project, the Uptown Dubai district. Mr Bin Sulayem currently serves as the Chairman of the Dubai Diamond Exchange (DDE) and the Dubai Gold & Commodities Exchange (DGCX). The Kimberley Process officially appointed the United Arab Emirates (UAE) as the first and only Arab country to Chair the Kimberley Process (KP) in November 2015. Shortly after, the UAE Ministry of Economy officially appointed Mr Bin Sulayem as the UAE’s Chair of the KP for 2016. Mr Bin Sulayem was reappointed Chair of the KP for a historic second time in 2024 and has continued his leadership role with the position of Custodian Chair of the KP in 2025. He has also advised public and private institutions, political leaders, and high-net-worth individuals, focusing on the intersection of innovation, finance, technology, and societal impact. His career reflects a consistent commitment to bridging traditional finance and emerging technologies in an increasingly digital economy.

He is also a Board Member of Bloom, a Colombian company active in the equity crowdfunding sector, and Board Advisor of Mobile Streams PLC, a gaming and e-sports company listed on the AIM market in London. In addition to direct investment and advisory roles, Alessandro has contributed to educational and institutional initiatives, serving on the Advisory Board of Woodfield Christian University where he lectures on Fintech Management. He is also Vice President of the ""Alimentando un Niño"" Foundation, dedicated to improving the nutrition of disadvantaged children. With decades of experience across finance, fintech, and international markets, Alessandro Ciacchini brings a global vision and hands-on expertise to businesses and institutions seeking sustainable growth and innovation.

During his tenure, he shepherded the first adoption of a new regulation in over a decade, led reforms to the Commission’s investigation and interagency practices, and authored more than 150 Statements of Reasons interpreting the Federal Election Campaign Act. Previously, he was Legal Director of the Institute for Free Speech, where he led a nationwide First Amendment practice. He has also worked as a litigation associate in the New York office of Kirkland & Ellis LLP. Dickerson is a Major in the Judge Advocate General’s Corps, U.S. Army Reserve, an Adjunct Professor at the University of Mississippi School of Law, and an Advisory Member of the American Bar Association’s Standing Committee on Election Law. He received his education at Yale College and New York University School of Law.

He graduated from Stanford University with B.S. and M.S. degrees in Computer Science, and was a member of the Mayfield Fellows Program. He earned an EMBA degree from CEIBS in China. name: H.E. Daniel Azzopardi
title: Ambassador of Malta to Italy
bio: Daniel Azzopardi started his career in the Malta Civil Service in 2007 following a Government Scholarship on European Affairs at the University of Sussex, UK. In 2018 Mr Azzopardi was appointed Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary, Permanent Representative of Malta to the European Union. In August 2020 he was then appointed as Malta’s Ambassador to the Kingdom of Spain. Ambassador Azzopardi has been appointed Ambassador to the Italian Republic on 30th August 2024. Ambassador Azzopardi holds a master’s degree in Contemporary European Studies, from the University of Sussex (UK), and a Bachelor of Arts (Hons) in European Studies from the University of Malta. bio: Hicham Chahine is Co-Founder and Co-CEO of NIP Group (NASDAQ: NIPG), where he is leading the company's rapid expansion into Bitcoin mining and digital infrastructure. Under his leadership, NIPG scaled from zero to 11.3 EH/s of Bitcoin mining capacity in under six months, establishing the company as one of the fastest-growing public miners globally, and the largest in the MENA region. Prior to NIPG's digital infrastructure expansion, Hicham acquired the esports organization Ninjas in Pyjamas in 2016 and built it into a global gaming and entertainment platform reaching hundreds of millions of fans. His background spans finance and entrepreneurship - from 2008 to 2016, he directed hedge fund investments at Formue, the Nordic region's largest wealth management firm, and in 2010 founded Diglife AS, a private equity firm focused on lifestyle, gaming, and technology investments. Hicham brings a unique perspective to Bitcoin mining through his combination of financial markets experience, operational scale-up expertise, and deep understanding of digital communities and fan engagement. He is based in Abu Dhabi, where NIPG operates under a partnership framework with the Abu Dhabi Investment Office. He holds a bachelor's degree in business and economics from BI Norwegian Business School.

name: Hon. Alex Borg
title: Leader of the Opposition
bio: "Alex Borg, born on 10 June 1995 in Victoria, Gozo, is a lawyer and politician who currently serves as Leader of the Nationalist Party. He was first elected to the Maltese Parliament in 2022, securing the highest number of votes among Nationalist Party candidates after the party leader at the time. Over the past three years, he has served as Shadow Minister for Gozo and has been a member of both the Parliamentary Committee for Gozo and the Committee for Foreign Affairs. Raised in Nadur, Borg pursued his education at the Bishop's Conservatory, Gozo College, and Sir M. A. Refalo Sixth Form. He graduated with a degree in Law in 2019 and subsequently commenced practice as a lawyer. In 2019, Borg was elected to the Executive of the Nationalist Party Youth Movement, followed shortly thereafter by his election to the Nationalist Party Executive Committee. His commitment to grassroots engagement reflects his conviction that effective politics requires direct and sustained contact between elected representatives and their constituents. Borg's political philosophy centres on fostering a robust and competitive economy while maintaining comprehensive social services. He advocates for a balanced approach that promotes economic growth alongside social equity. Following the resignation of Nationalist Party Leader Dr Bernard Grech in June 2025, Borg announced his candidacy for the leadership position. On 6 September 2025, he was elected Leader of the Nationalist Party, marking a significant milestone in his political trajectory."

name: Hon. Antonio Tajani

bio: Professional journalist since 1980, he has worked as a parliamentary reporter, anchor for GR1 Rai, and head of the Rome newsroom of Il Giornale. Co-founder of Forza Italia, he served as its Vice President from 2018 to 2023 and as National Coordinator from 2021 to 2024. On February 24, 2024, he was unanimously elected National Secretary of Forza Italia. Since 2002, he has been Vice President of the European People’s Party. In 1994, he was elected to the European Parliament for the first time. He was appointed European Commissioner for Transport in 2008, and later Vice President and European Commissioner for Industry and Entrepreneurship in 2010. On January 17, 2017, he was elected President of the European Parliament. From 2019 to 2022, he served as Chair of the Committee on Constitutional Affairs and of the Conference of Committee Chairs of the European Parliament. Since October 22, 2022, he has been Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation.

Before his election to Parliament in 2022, he served as Deputy Mayor of Asti (2017–2022) with responsibility for economic development and the promotion of local entrepreneurship, and had previously held various municipal roles in Asti since 2002. In the Chamber of Deputies, he serves on the Public and Private Labour Committee, the Committee on Elections, and the Parliamentary Committee of Inquiry into workplace conditions and safety. He also serves as Chair of the Inter-Parliamentary Committee on Digital Assets, Blockchain and Bitcoin, engaging with industry and institutions to promote clear, responsible rules for virtual assets that protect consumers while supporting competitiveness and growth.

name: Hon. Roberta Metsola
title: President
bio: Hon. Roberta Metsola was elected President of the European Parliament in January 2022, becoming the youngest ever person to occupy this role. In July 2024, she was re-elected for another term, as only the second person and first woman to serve as President for two terms. President Metsola has been very vocal and firm in Europe’s support to Ukraine, following Russia’s brutal invasion. On 1st April 2022, she became the first President of an institution of the European Union to visit Ukraine since the start of the war. As President, she has led reforms towards a Parliament that is more modern, efficient and accountable. She was first elected as a Member of the European Parliament in 2013. Prior, President Metsola served within the Permanent Representation of Malta to the European Union and later as the legal advisor to the High Representative of the European Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy. In her student years, she campaigned actively for Malta's European Union membership. Professionally she is a lawyer who has specialised in European law and politics. Born in 1979, Roberta Metsola is married to Ukko Metsola and is the mother of four boys.

bio: Web3 entrepreneur with 15+ years of experience spanning financial product sales, project management, and FinTech innovation. My career began in traditional finance, where I spent 13 years building commercial and operational expertise before transitioning into cybersecurity and blockchain. Igor serves as Chief Growth Officer at Hacken, where he works on blockchain security challenges and strategic growth initiatives, supporting the development of robust and secure Web3 ecosystems. His focus lies in bridging traditional finance with decentralized technologies, driving adoption, and scaling secure blockchain solutions.

Since 2001, Imma has been working in the field of legal gaming and is a member of working groups within Confindustria (SGI/CSIT) and Confcommercio (EGP/FIPE). Imma is an EFPA-certified ESG Advisor and a professional member of FERPI, the Italian Federation of Public Relations. She was honoured with the title of Ambassador of “Gli Stati Generali delle Donne” for her personal and professional commitment to combating gender-based violence and promoting equality.

Israel served as the Chief Operating Officer at Rational Group (PokerStars) from February 2006 to August 2016, where they were responsible for various operational and audit roles. Rosenthal oversaw a wide range of functions, including customer support, game integrity, security, payments, and resource management. In October 2016, Rosenthal became the CEO of MuchBetter, an app-based payment wallet that provides secure and economical e-payment solutions for customers and merchants worldwide.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Ivan Filletti
title: CEO
bio: Ivan Filletti has served as CEO of the GamingMalta Foundation since 2016, leading efforts to position Malta as a global leader in the gaming sector. Established by the Government of Malta and the Malta Gaming Authority (MGA), the Foundation under Ivan's guidance has significantly enhanced Malta's reputation as a jurisdiction for gaming innovation. In addition to his responsibilities as CEO, Ivan chairs the government-backed iGaming Council, where he continues to shape regulatory frameworks and advance Malta's prominence in global gaming.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Ivan Kan
title: CMO
bio: Ivan Kan is the CMO of T7X, an SEC-registered transfer agent on a mission to rebuild capital markets from the ground up. T7X is rewriting the rules of securities issuance. Built on compliance-first blockchain infrastructure, T7X is one of the only platforms in the world where tokenization happens at the moment of issuance. The token is not a wrapper. It is not a proof of ownership. It is the security itself. No intermediaries. No receipts. No synthetic exposure. Just direct, programmable ownership of real assets, issued inside U.S. securities law from day one. Where legacy markets restricted access to capital formation behind layers of gatekeepers, T7X tears that down. Investors get 24/7 liquidity. Issuers get a direct line to capital. And every transaction settles on-chain, transparently, in real time. Capital Markets. Rebuilt. A Forbes contributor, Ivan writes on market structure, the future of ownership, and the infrastructure decisions that will determine whether tokenization delivers on its promise or repeats the same failures with better branding. Beyond his operating role, Ivan is a global entrepreneur with one successful exit and an active portfolio as an investor and board member across disruptive technology companies and early-stage ventures.

name: Ivan Montik

bio: Ivan Montik is the founder of SOFTSWISS. The strongest supporter of cryptocurrency, Ivan empowered SOFTSWISS to become the first company to introduce Bitcoin into the online gambling industry in 2013. From its beginnings as a small outsourcing startup, SOFTSWISS has reached a global scale under Ivan's leadership. Now employing over 2,000 people worldwide and winning over 30 prestigious industry awards.

name: Jaime Debono

bio: Jamie Debono has over 11 years of experience in the gaming industry. In 2015, he co-founded iGaming Academy to deliver industry-specific and regulatory training for operators and suppliers. Now the largest training provider in the sector, it trains over 60,000 professionals annually. In April 2024, SiGMA Group acquired a majority stake in iGaming Academy, integrating education into its global events and expanding its reach across the industry.

bio: Founder of Bridger, a Bitcoin mining company dedicated to partnering with African nations to expand energy infrastructure and drive national productivity through mining operations. He brings over two decades of international experience from his service with the U.S. Department of Defense across Europe, Asia, and Africa. As a guest author at the Bitcoin Policy Institute, Langenkamp applies his global perspective to advancing innovative approaches to energy development and Bitcoin mining.

name: Jake Salerno
title: VP of GTM
bio: Jake leads Business Development at Zero Gravity Labs, where he built and oversees the team responsible for driving ecosystem integrations and strategic go-to-market execution. Since mid-2024, he has built and led a high-impact BD team while directly managing Tier 1 operational partners across the most critical verticals. Under his leadership, 0G has secured over 350 integrations across its modular decentralized AI infrastructure stack. Jake works closely with stakeholders across the 60+ person team, including product, legal, engineering, and marketing, to shape ecosystem strategy, accelerate adoption, and align 0G’s core infrastructure with the needs of its most strategic partners. Prior to 0G, he spent three years at Chainlink Labs leading go-to-market for data products, contributing to over $1 trillion in Total Value Secured through product adoption. A founder with nearly a decade in crypto, Jake has built and exited multiple startups and remains an active contributor to the broader Web3 and AI ecosystems.

name: James Delmore
title: Blockchain & Crypto Analyst
bio: James Delmore is a Blockchain and Crypto Market Analyst at Breadcrumbs, where he conducts on-chain investigations and produces investigative reports that have been covered by CNBC, Fox Business and others. James also held analyst roles at Figment, Chorus One, and Solidus Labs, covering everything from the staking market to digital asset regulatory analysis. Prior to working in the crypto industry, he was a Researcher at Fox News from 2016 to 2021. James holds an M.A. in Communication from Tel Aviv University and is based in New York and Miami.

name: James Spiteri Staines

He later joined a major CSP, expanding his accounting expertise with national and international clients. In 2018 he became a sole practitioner providing audit and accounting services, before co-founding Beacon Finance Ltd in 2020, where he now serves as Accounts and Payroll Director.

name: Jamie King
title: CMO
bio: Jamie King is the Chief Marketing Officer of Minutes Network, a telecommunications and DePIN ecosystem that brings blockchain-powered infrastructure to one of the world's largest industries. His work spans the growth and adoption of Minutes Network's expanding ecosystem, including MNTx, the utility token powering network participation; Unetwork, a global mobile edge network; and Jingle, a developer platform that creates new revenue opportunities through telecommunications infrastructure. Jamie's focus is on helping scale real-world blockchain adoption through technologies that connect traditional telecom operators, mobile applications, network participants, and decentralized infrastructure. The ecosystem is designed to create tangible utility at a global scale, combining carrier-grade telecommunications with Web3-enabled participation models. While many know Jamie as a co-founder of Rockstar Games, where he helped build one of the most successful and influential companies in entertainment history and contributed to iconic franchises including Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption, his career has since spanned telecommunications, esports, media, technology, and Web3. A BAFTA Lifetime Achievement recipient, he has spent more than 30 years launching, scaling, and advising category-defining businesses across multiple industries, helping bring innovative technologies and products to global audiences.

A co-founder of Rome Blockchain Labs, an incubator focused on DeFi innovation, and BENQI, a lending protocol on Avalanche that reached $4B in TVL post-launch, JD has experience scaling protocols from early-stage development to enterprise adoption. His background in financial planning, business consulting, and digital strategy helps him address risks, regulations, and opportunities with institutions and projects of all sizes.

An ardent crypto enthusiast campaigning for change in the African Fintech world through the adoption of cryptocurrencies as a means of exchange and payment throughout the continent. Jeremiah is also a marketing and investment professional with extensive experience in advertising, marketing, and startup consulting for African gambling businesses. He is the current CEO of igasummit.com, igamingafrika.com and Founding Director of iGaming Consult Africa and AfriAdz Affiliates.

With more than 20 years of experience helping businesses and governments navigate technological change, Jeremy has advised governments around the world, including Mexico, Canada, the United Arab Emirates, and Bahrain. He has held senior leadership roles at global agencies such as Publicis Groupe and Real Chemistry, and previously served as Press Secretary to Illinois Governor Rod Blagojevich.

name: Jessica Maier
title: Co-Founder & Director
company: EGARA – Executive Gaming and Risk Advisory
bio: Jessica Maier is an internationally recognised advisor in the global gaming industry, trusted by operators, suppliers, investors, and policymakers for her expertise in regulation, licensing, risk, and compliance. As the Co-Founder of EGARA – Executive Gaming and Risk Advisory, she helps clients use compliance as a driver of growth, transform regulatory complexity into competitive advantage, and approach risk as a source of strategic opportunity. Her career includes executive leadership roles as Chief Risk Officer, Head of Legal & Compliance, and Head of Government Affairs at leading gaming software companies, as well as Partner at a specialist gaming law firm. She has managed multiple international B2C and B2B licensing projects, advised on major M&A transactions, and strengthened governance frameworks to support long-term success. Jessica serves on the Board of Trustees of the International Association of Gaming Advisors (IAGA) and co-chairs its EMEA Engagement Committee. She is widely respected for her pragmatic approach and her ability to build constructive relationships with regulators and industry stakeholders worldwide.

With a business background in coal and agriculture, he is known for championing economic innovation in West Virginia, including support for emerging technologies like Bitcoin. Justice advocates for pro-growth policies that aim to transform traditional energy regions into technology hubs while reinforcing West Virginia's leadership in energy production.

With more than a decade of experience in affiliation, he has worked across startups and publicly listed companies in roles ranging from Technical Product Owner to VP Product. His current focus is on advanced tracking, giving affiliates greater control of their data through solutions such as click level attribution, CRM integration and full funnel attribution.

name: Joe Kelly
title: Co-founder and CEO
bio: Co-founder and CEO of Unchained, where he has led the company since 2016 in building a platform that secures over $10 billion in bitcoin through self-custody solutions, trading, commercial lending, and IRA services. Under his leadership, Unchained has grown into a venture-backed firm with over 100 employees and more than $100 million in funding, pioneering a new category of bitcoin-native financial services. He also serves on the board of the Texas Bitcoin Foundation, a nonprofit dedicated to advancing Bitcoin research and education.

Throughout his career, Joe has been passionate about delivering earned media at scale and that discipline sits as the core of Volume Communications client output.

name: Joey Ingram

bio: Joe Ingram, also known as ‘Chicago Joey’ or ‘BigPapi’, is a multifaceted poker personality known for his impactful presence in the poker media landscape. Ingram’s journey into poker began with a keen interest in competitive gaming. He transitioned to poker during his college years, initially dabbling in micro-stakes online. His strategic acumen and relentless work ethic would soon propel him to higher stakes, where he achieved further success and recognition. Beyond his achievements as a player, Ingram is widely acknowledged for his contributions to the poker community through various media platforms. His podcast, ‘ The Joe Ingram Poker Life Podcast’, became a staple for poker enthusiasts, featuring in-depth interviews with top players, industry experts and personalities.

John has extensive gambling law, regulatory and licensing experience having advised major international clients on matters ranging from license applications, compliance investigations and license reviews to M&A related specialist gambling advice.

name: John Koudounis
title: President and CEO
bio: John Koudounis serves as the President and CEO of Calamos Investments, the third largest liquid alternatives asset manager in the US. Under his leadership, the firm’s AUM has surged to over $46 billion, nearly tripling since he took the helm in 2016. Notably, he has overseen the launch of innovative products, including the world's first suite of downside-protected Bitcoin ETFs. With over 37 years of experience in the financial services sector, he previously held the position of President and CEO at Mizuho Securities in the Americas, where he significantly expanded the firm's capital markets teams and enhanced profitability, client base, and product diversity, elevating Mizuho to a top-tier global investment bank. In addition to his corporate responsibilities, Koudounis is recognized for his thought leadership, frequently speaking at global conferences and platforms such as CNBC, Fox Business, and Bloomberg TV. Koudounis is committed to philanthropy and is involved with several organizations including the Concordia Leadership Council, the SEAL Future Foundation, The Hellenic Initiative, and the Ecumenical Bartholomew Foundation. He holds a degree in International Diplomacy & Foreign Affairs and Economics from Brown University.

name: John Medel
title: Head of Public Policy
bio: John Medel oversees policy and regulatory engagement at the Injective Policy Institute, where he promotes responsible innovation across the digital assets space, including tokenization, RWAs, and on-chain lending. Prior to this, he was part of Coinbase’s Public Policy team, where he focused on international regulations and led market entry efforts in India, Turkey, Brazil, and Canada. He also served as a Vice President in Government Affairs at Goldman Sachs, specializing in the post-Dodd-Frank regulatory environment and cross-border investments and acquisitions. Mr. Medel holds master’s degrees from London School of Economics in International Political Economy and Georgetown University in American Government and National Security Studies.

source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Jonathan Ovadia
title: CEO
bio: As the Founder and CEO of OVEX, Jonathan Ovadia is at the forefront of institutional Bitcoin adoption in Africa. With a strong background in Electrical and Computer Engineering from the University of Cape Town, Jonathan views market inefficiencies as engineering problems—and has built OVEX into the region's premier infrastructure for digital asset settlement and liquidity. Jonathan is widely recognized for democratizing access to global finance for the continent's largest enterprises. He has been instrumental in opening up institutional access to Bitcoin, establishing the secure, high-volume payment rails required for companies to use cryptocurrency as a real-time settlement layer for cross-border trade and corporate treasury management. Having processed billions in volume, Jonathan is re-defining the utility of Bitcoin and stablecoins for African commerce.

name: Josefin Uppeke

bio: Josefin Uppeke has been in game production since 2016 and has worked across multiple studios and countries, leading projects from concept to launch. She is now Senior Product Owner at Wicked Games, creating bold, edgy titles alongside modern twists on the classics. Naturally outgoing and collaborative, she brings teams together and keeps the creative flow moving in the right direction. What drives her is building experiences that connect with players, games that stand out, surprise people and have that spark of rebellion and purpose.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Joseph Collement
title: Chief Legal Officer and Head of Media
bio: Joseph is a licensed attorney in the U.S. and founder of thecryptolawyers.com (est. 2017), a crypto-only law firm where he represented top players in the industry. Joseph has been an executive at Bitcoin.com since 2020 and leads the media, legal and compliance teams. Joseph is also a regular contributor to various financial and crypto online publications such as Coindesk, Fortune, Yahoo Finance, and Cointelegraph.

name: Joseph Dallago
title: CEO & Co-Founder
bio: Joseph Dallago is the Co-Founder and CEO of Rain, the first licensed and largest region-born cryptocurrency exchange in the Middle East and North Africa. He began coding at age 13 and has spent more than a decade building technology companies, founding and exiting two startups before Rain. Joseph entered the crypto space in 2013 and has been closely involved in its evolution, particularly across the Middle East. Under his leadership, Rain secured the region’s first crypto license with the Central Bank of Bahrain in 2017 and expanded its regulatory footprint by obtaining an ADGM licence in 2023. Rain has since grown to more than one million sign-ups and raised 110 million USD from global investors including Coinbase, Kleiner Perkins, and Paradigm. Joseph remains focused on expanding financial access and driving responsible crypto adoption across the region.

Prior to Bitwise, he was a Portfolio Manager at U.S. Global Investors managing equity and fixed-income funds, and designed quantitative investment strategies. Before that, Juan was a Financial Analyst at Rackspace Technology where he contributed to financial planning and analysis. He is a graduate of Trinity University, double majoring in Political Science and Economics. Juan also earned the Chartered Financial Analyst designation from the CFA Institute.

name: Kamaru Usman
title: UFC Welterweight Champion
bio: Kamarudeen "Kamaru" Usman is one of the most recognisable fighters of our time. His nickname, The Nigerian Nightmare, was earned for a reason. He made history in the UFC as the welterweight champion, holding the title from 2019 to 2022. His record-breaking win streak — 15 consecutive victories in the division — included successful title defences against some of the toughest opponents. He is also known as one of the most disciplined and strategically-minded athletes in the world of mixed martial arts. The choice of Kamaru Usman as an ambassador for MelBet Partners is both strategic and symbolic. It reflects the values the company promotes in working with its partners: strength, discipline, strategy, and leadership.

name: Karen Jouve
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Karen Jouve is an entrepreneur and innovation leader at the crossroads of Web3, AI and immersive technologies. She co-founded Doors3, launched Elevators3 and is building Beyond, an AI-powered travel business agent redefining premium business travel. A Navy reservist and athlete, she regularly speaks at top global stages and contributes to leading media. Based between France and Dubai, Karen is committed to empowering leaders and advancing women in tech worldwide.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

Over more than 15 years, he has overseen complex cross-border projects, guided leading enterprises through regulatory challenges and positioned the firm at the forefront of innovation. Karl has also spearheaded the development of MAIA, a structured logic AI platform designed to transform business operations. His leadership combines strategic insight with a commitment to technology-driven solutions.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Karolina Pelc
title: Founder
bio: Karolina Pelc has spent over two decades navigating the male-dominated world of real-money gaming, building a career that spans from dealing cards in brick-and-mortar and cruise ship casinos to leading some of the industry’s most influential companies. She held senior leadership roles at Betsson Group, William Hill Online, and LeoVegas (MGM), and later served as a board director for the Nasdaq-listed Gaming Innovation Group. In 2021, Karolina founded BeyondPlay, an engagement SaaS start-up, raising over €7M in angel and VC funding and guiding it through one of the fastest exits in the sector with its 2024 acquisition by FanDuel, the #1 gaming brand in the US. She then served as Vice President at FanDuel, steering product integration and expansion. Alongside her executive career, Karolina advises VC firms, founders, and M&A transactions, while mentoring and investing in early-stage entrepreneurs through her platform, HerPlay. Her debut book Her Play, launched in a limited gifting edition on Necker Island in 2025, chronicles her journey from casino floors to startup boardrooms, with a commercial release planned for Spring 2026. Named a LinkedIn Top Startup Voice and one of iGaming’s Top 10 Most Influential Women, Karolina continues to speak globally, blending storytelling with actionable insights to inspire bold reinvention.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Karolis Dula
title: Head of Payments
bio: Karolis Dula leads payments at Alea, where he built and scaled Alea Pay from the ground up. Launched in 2025, Alea Pay was designed to solve a problem Karolis understood firsthand: payments in iGaming are fragmented, complex and often unreliable. Under his leadership, Alea Pay has grown globally, bringing tailored payment methods, exclusive provider partnerships and bank grade API security to operators in challenging markets. Before Alea, Karolis spent over five years in fintech at Genome and Mistertango, focusing on international payments for high risk merchants.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

He began his career as a horseracing bookmaker at Quotenhaus GmbH before joining Tipico in 2016, where he led Retail Shop Compliance and oversaw licensing, regulatory processes and audits. Since 2025, Karsten has been driving Tipico's public policy strategy, advocating in regulatory discussions and contributing expert insights to shape the future of the gambling industry.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

Educated at Uppsala University, she brings an international perspective and speaks several languages. Under her leadership, NOWPayments has expanded its global presence, emphasising innovative crypto payment solutions and the adoption of stablecoins, which now account for nearly half of all transactions on the platform.

Her focus for 2026 is on building out the Regulatory Programme, prioritising the Sustainable Gambling Zone and attracting Big Tech companies to ICE to integrate into the global gaming ecosystem. Mags has over 20 years’ experience in event management, magazine publishing and content production.

name: Margeaux Plaisted
title: Vice President of Policy and Government Relations
bio: Vice President of Policy and Government Relations at CleanSpark, where she leads the company's policy strategy and legislative outreach. With over 20 years of experience in government relations, she specializes in bridging the gap between lawmakers, regulators, and industry leaders on issues related to digital assets, energy policy, and financial regulation. Plaisted is a recognized leader in advancing Bitcoin mining policy and driving innovative, bipartisan legislative solutions.

name: Margie Feng
title: Head of Marketing
bio: Margie Feng leads marketing at Solayer, where she is currently focused on Solayer Pay. With a background spanning crypto and global brand building, she specializes in translating complex technical products into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with users. Previously at FuzzLand and BITMAIN, Margie led high-impact campaigns, global events, and influencer programs, helping build strong ecosystems across Web3.

name: Margot Paez
title: Fellow
bio: A Fellow at the Bitcoin Policy Institute and is completing her PhD in Civil Engineering at Georgia Institute of Technology, where she specializes in climate change statistical modeling with a focus on water resources. She holds an MS in Physics from Georgia Tech and brings diverse research experience in robotics, astrobiology instrumentation, and physics of living systems. She combines expertise in data management systems and advanced statistical modeling to address environmental challenges while contributing to Bitcoin policy discussions.

name: Maria Vovchok
title: Head of BD&Media Lead
bio: Maria Vovchok is an accomplished media professional and distinguished conference MC with over a decade of experience in media and more than eight years in blockchain, fintech, and Web3 communications. Recognized for her articulate and insightful approach, Maria bridges complex technological subjects with broad and diverse audiences across global markets. She began her Web3 journey as a news editor and anchor at several blockchain media outlets, later transitioning into marketing and PR roles within blockchain companies. Over the years, she has built strong relationships with VC funds, angel investors, and startup founders. Maria has served as an MC and moderator at numerous tech and business conferences worldwide. Her distinguished presence has been sought by premier events such as TOKEN2049, Hong Kong FinTech Week, LEAP Riyadh, and more. She also served as Managing Director of the World of Web3 Summit, and was a contributing TV host at Moniify. Currently, Maria is the Head of Business Development & Media Lead at the Dubai Blockchain Center, where she also hosts the Encrypted podcast, interviewing top voices in the Web3 ecosystem. She has also recently joined Gate as a Digital Producer & Host. Beyond her professional work, Maria holds an ambassadorial role with the Blockchain Association of Ukraine, and has been honored as one of the Top 25 Women in Fintech & Blockchain in MENA by DX Talks.

name: Mariangel Garcia
title: Co-Founder
bio: Mariangel Garcia is the Co-Founder of the Women in Investment Network (WIIN), a global circle that unites women investors, venture leaders, and visionaries who move capital. Through WIIN, she is advancing the mission of connecting women with curated investment opportunities, strategic alliances, and exclusive intelligence to redefine leadership, wealth, and legacy for generations to come. She is an experienced Digital Marketing Strategist in the FinTech and Blockchain industries, with a proven track record in market expansion, community building, and business development. Previously, Mariangel led marketing and community initiatives at Binance Latin America and served as Head of Communities at BNB Chain, driving large-scale adoption and growth. Named one of the Most Influential Women in Crypto 2024 by BeInCrypto, Mariangel is also a TEDx Speaker and U.S. Department of State Alumna, recognized for her thought leadership and frequent contributions at international conferences across the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East. With 8+ years of experience in digital financial solutions, she is driven by a passion for financial inclusion, blockchain adoption, and empowering diverse leaders to shape the future of investment and technology.

name: Mariia Grinko
title: HR Team Lead
bio: Mariia is the HR Team Lead at Private inc., one of the largest media buying holdings in the CIS. Mariia and her team are known for their skills in attracting top talent in a short timeframe, as well as their ability to develop effective strategies for employee retention. Mariia is recognized for her technical approach to hiring and her deep understanding of the industry. Every HR professional should be able to independently and accurately assess candidates—this is Mariia's core principle!

He partners with the region's top companies, leveraging unique data to uncover critical trends in app categories and user behavior. Mariusz spearheads key initiatives that accelerate the growth of the mobile ecosystem in CEE and has guided many of Google's largest clients in developing and executing winning mobile strategies. A recognized thought leader, he is a frequent speaker at industry conferences and the founder of GameCamp (www.gamecamp.io), a premier European community for mobile gaming and app professionals. He also leads an angel investment community, bringing together specialists in gaming, apps, AI, and the Cloud from over 15 countries.

He spearheads Kea, a group of licensed entities powering global finance with one KYB across banking, stablecoins, and crypto, supported by a custom core banking system, and a human-touch approach. A recognised authority in banking, fintech, neobanks, and the payments industry, Mark's insights into stablecoins and the broader crypto ecosystem make him a sought-after speaker on global panels.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Mark Connors
title: CEO, Chief Macro Strategist
bio: Mark Connors is the founder of Risk Dimensions, an OCRO (Outsourced Chief Risk Officer) advisory that integrates his 35 years of institutional investment and financing experience with the recent advancements of bitcoin and AI. His career spans trading desks, multi-strategy hedge funds, and client-facing data strategy roles at Credit Suisse. More recently, Mark led research at 3iQ during the 2022–23 crypto winter, where he applied behavioral finance, debt-cycle frameworks, and traditional risk models to contextualize the crisis—not as a protocol failure, but a failure of market participants. This cross-disciplinary perspective drives his current research and consulting practice that demonstrates bitcoin is no longer a speculative anomaly and warrants inclusion in any multi-asset portfolio across the risk-reward spectrum.

name: Mark Curmi
title: Non-Executive Director
bio: Mark Curmi is an established financial services professional with over 20 years experience in financial services through various roles at International Credit Institutions, BIG 4 Advisory Firm and Fintech outfits. He is currently the CEO and Executive at Trumia Ltd and member of the Institute of Financial Services Practitioners (ISFP) in Malta, the Malta Chamber of Commerce and the SME Chamber. Prior to joining Trumia Ltd, Mr. Curmi was heavily involved in the establishment of fintech outfit Andaria Financial Services Ltd, an EMI/ASPSP based in Malta and the UK.

With deep knowledge of both game development and AI, Mark has successfully positioned XGENIA at the forefront of an AI revolution in iGaming. His relentless pursuit of innovation ensures that XGENIA continues to push the boundaries of what’s possible in AI-driven gaming.

name: Mark Galea Salomone
title: Managing Associate
bio: Mark Galea Salomone is a Managing Associate in the tax team at WH Partners. He has extensive experience in corporate tax, having previously served as a Tax Senior Associate with Dentons in the UK's London office and worked in KPMG UK’s corporate tax department. Mark advises domestic and international clients on complex UK, Maltese, and cross-border tax matters, including tax restructuring, inbound and outbound investment, corporate finance, mergers and acquisitions, and private wealth tax law. His clients include private equity houses, leading multinationals, financial institutions, and companies in the technology and crypto sectors. He has contributed to leading publications such as Cahiers de droit fiscal international (International Fiscal Association), International Tax Review, and Tax Journal. Mark is dual-qualified as both a lawyer and an accountant. He holds an LL.M. in Tax from the London School of Economics and an LL.D. (Doctor of Laws) from the University of Malta, and he is also a Chartered Certified Accountant (ACCA).
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Mark Ghatan
title: Senior Wealth Strategist
bio: Mark Ghatan is a Senior Wealth Strategist at Bespoke Group, an advisory firm serving high-net-worth individuals and families with complex, non-traditional wealth. He is a trust and estate attorney specializing in advanced planning for digital assets, closely held businesses, and multi-jurisdictional structures, advising on trust and ownership frameworks that balance control, continuity, tax efficiency, and long-term stewardship. With a background in complex investigations and security consulting, Mark takes a security-first approach to structuring wealth, helping clients, particularly those with concentrated crypto holdings, navigate risks around custody, jurisdiction, and personal safety.

He helps ambitious businesses in complex, saturated markets stand out, stay ahead and build brands that sell more…because a good product gets you in the game but a great brand is how you win it. As the co-founder of Factory 39, Martin has worked with global names like FIFA, eBay, Dr. Oetker, BT, Muskita, BBF, HFM and Sharp, as well as scale-ups across Tech, Finance, and SaaS. His motto? Stop hiding. Start branding. Oh, and he likes pickle juice."
