Martina is also a legal intern at an audit and tax firm, where she is exposed to company, employment, gaming, aviation, and maritime law. This experience provides her with valuable insight into how law operates in practice and strengthens her analytical and research skills. In 2025, Martina won the first edition of the SiGMA writing competition, organised in collaboration with Filletti & Filletti Advocates and the University of Malta, with her article ‘Beyond the Algorithm: Regulating AI Accountability in the Gaming Industry’. This achievement has deepened Martina’s interest in gaming law, and she looks forward to building on these experiences as she continues developing her academic and professional career.

Recognized among CoinTelegraph’s Top 100 Most Influential Figures in Blockchain and Cryptocurrencies (2022), he also served on the World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council on Cryptocurrencies. Through his leadership, Dr. Al Zarouni continues to position Dubai as a global hub for blockchain and Bitcoin innovation.

name: Mary Beth Buchanan

She was the first woman and youngest person to hold that role, and also served in senior Department of Justice positions, including Acting Director of the Office on Violence Against Women. Following her government career, she has held leadership roles in law, finance, and crypto, including General Counsel at Kraken and executive positions at blockchain and fintech companies. She currently acts as Vice President on the Board of Directors of the Cardano Foundation.

Lynaugh is also a co-founder of ATX DAO and was recognized on Forbes’ 30 Under 30 Austin for his work advancing Web3 adoption and policy engagement.

Specialising in strategic planning, risk management, compliance, customer experience optimisation, business development, and process automation, Mauro thrives in fast-paced environments.

bio: Michael Martin is a leading expert in institutional crypto advisory and private wealth management, currently serving as Senior Relationship Manager for Digital Asset Banking at Bank Julius Baer, one of world’s most respected private banks. With a career spanning 20 years across global financial centers— including Zurich, London, and Dubai — Michael has helped bridge the gap between traditional finance and the rapidly evolving world of digital assets. At Julius Baer, he advises a global client base of entrepreneurs, family offices, and institutional investors on the seamless integration of crypto assets into long-term wealth strategies. At the intersection of regulation, innovation, and client-centric advisory, Michael empowers clients to access Bitcoin and digital assets through secure custody, financial products, and strategic portfolio solutions. Within the robust Swiss banking framework, Michael is shaping the future of digital asset banking — one relationship at a time.

name: Michael Mosier

He previously served as Acting Director of FinCEN, where he helped shape U.S. policy around Bitcoin and digital privacy, and held senior roles at OFAC, the DOJ, and the National Security Council.

name: Michael Peterson
title: Director
bio: Michael Peterson is the creative mind behind the Bitcoin Beach project that spurred the government of El Salvador to embrace Bitcoin as legal tender. The adoption of Bitcoin has put El Salvador in the spotlight as the unlikely catalyst to upend the worlds current monetary order established in Brenton Woods. Michael and his team have demonstrated how an open monetary system can overcome the challenges of bringing financial inclusion to those of the bottom rung of the economic ladder living in the most challenging of environments. In the past few years there have been hundreds of articles from major publications and dozens of film crews covering Bitcoin Beach and the revolution that it has sparked. The coverage of Bitcoin Beach from media giants like 60 Minutes and HBO have helped move the mainstream narrative about Bitcoin from “Bros and Lambos” to “financial inclusion and self sovereignty” for those previously trapped in destructive cycles of poverty.

name: Muhammad Rasoul
title: CEO
bio: As the CEO of amana, Muhammad Rasoul is a strong supporter of transparency, building financial literacy, and ensuring everyone has both the opportunity and the learning tools to scale the heights of the investment world. And by laying the groundwork for a more transparent approach to multi-asset trading and investing, he is steering amana into the forefront of a more innovative and accessible regional financial industry. Over the course of his 25-year career, Rasoul has established a global presence as a financial industry innovator and thought leader. His expertise as a growth strategist has been instrumental in the creation, expansion, and successful sale of multiple companies, including Gain Capital, GFT Markets, and B2B liquidity provider, Alpha. He has also advised the CFTC, NFA, ASIC, FCA, and FSA in Japan. Muhammad lives in Dubai with his wife, Sabina, and daughters Amirah and Alivia. In his spare time, he keeps in touch with Nadia, Yaseen, and Aiden, his three elder children, all of whom study and work in their native US. He is also an avid philosophy and history buff and can be found pouring over books about early American history. Last but not least, Muhammad is a fan of football and a long-time supporter of Chelsea Football Club!

name: Mushegh Khachatryan
title: Chief AI Officer
bio: Mushegh Khachatryan is the Chief AI Officer at SoftConstruct, one of the world’s leading gaming and technology groups. He leads the company’s global AI Center of Excellence, driving innovation across gaming, fintech, and enterprise solutions. With a strong background in economics and data science, Mushegh has built and scaled AI-driven products that power more than a thousand B2B partners worldwide. His mission is to turn AI from a buzzword into measurable business impact aligned with the EU AI Act.

He is the author of Anti-Riba Money: Dismantling Usury through Bitcoin, a recently published book that presents a compelling Islamic case for rejecting fiat and embracing Bitcoin. Active on both X and Nostr, he works to promote a deeper understanding of Bitcoin and its adoption within Muslim communities and organizations.

name: Nataliia Lavruk

She has successfully managed market entry strategies from the ground up, combining her experience as both affiliate and brand manager to ensure programs are effectively represented at major online and offline iGaming events worldwide. Her local market insights allow her to identify key trends and create affiliate-friendly environments that drive sustainable growth. A skilled negotiator and dedicated professional, Nataliia has built a robust global network of partners, particularly within less regulated markets. Passionate about collaboration, she consistently supports affiliates with actionable market intelligence, relevant traffic sources, and tailored messaging to maximise player acquisition.

name: Neil Jacobs
title: Founder
bio: Neil Jacobs is a leading marketing strategist, educator, and content creator in the Bitcoin industry. With a big-four CPA background and 150,000 social media followers, he has driven brand and revenue growth for prominent Bitcoin companies, including co-founding FOMO21.com—which has served customers in over 70 countries—and previously serving as Head of Brand Engagement at Swan Bitcoin. Neil’s Bitcoin journey began over a decade ago and he became a vocal advocate in the years that followed. Since then, he has hosted podcasts like Inside Bitcoin and served on the Board of Directors for SatsCenter, a nonprofit advancing Bitcoin education. Neil combines financial expertise with strategic vision to champion Bitcoin and foster its adoption globally.

name: Nestor Vazquez

bio: Meet Nestor Vazquez, a Mexico-based iGaming SEO strategist with a passion for turning clicks into jackpots. With years of experience in online casinos, sportsbooks, and gaming platforms, he combines data-driven insights with engaging storytelling to keep players interested and elevate brand rankings. Whether he's optimising a new slot site, scaling a sportsbook, or breaking into emerging markets, Nestor plays the long game because in SEO, just like in gaming, the house always wins when the strategy is smart.

Throughout her career, she has collaborated with Italian and European research institutes, becoming a consultant for the evaluation of reforms, public policies, and the performance of public administration. She is recognized as an expert in research methodology, a field in which she has contributed numerous publications for the European Commission. At Cuiprodest, she focuses particularly on analyzing the impact of proposed regulations on business models and on regulatory affairs with the Ministry of Health, as well as coordinating the activities of the Research Center. Since 2023, she has been a lecturer at Sapienza University of Rome.

name: Paul Boots
title: Head of Sector Development
bio: BIOGRAPHY Paul Boots - Head of Sector Development, Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) Paul Boots, Head of Sector Development at the Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA), brings with him a wealth of experience as a senior executive and entrepreneur with a proven track record in innovation, leadership, and market development. With a diverse background spanning financial services, strategy, and technology, Paul has been instrumental in shaping the Middle East’s peer-to-peer financing landscape, notably as the founding Group COO at Beehive, where he pioneered one of the region's first peer-to-peer lending platforms. His entrepreneurial expertise also extends to co-founding a boutique advisory firm that focuses on leadership development and strategy for large UAE-based companies, with a special focus on AI-driven technologies. Before these ventures, Paul played a key role in the executive leadership team at the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC), where he was instrumental in establishing Dubai as a global hub for trade across multiple industries. During his tenure, he conceptualized and built DMCC’s commodity trade finance platform, which facilitated Islamic banking partnerships. More recently, Paul led the development of a large B2B marketplace on behalf of the Investment Corporation of Dubai, further showcasing his ability to build innovative platforms that drive economic growth. A graduate of Babson College, Paul’s passion for leadership, entrepreneurship, and building high-performing teams is central to his approach. His appointment at VARA aligns with Dubai’s strategic goals under the D33 agenda, as Paul’s leadership in sector development will play a critical role in positioning the Emirate as a global leader in the virtual assets space. His unique blend of strategic insight and operational expertise are pivotal as VARA continues to shape the future of virtual asset regulation and innovation.

name: Paul Dawalibi

bio: Paul Dawalibi is a technology entrepreneur, investor, unicorn founder, futurist and gamer, with over 25 years of venture capital and startup experience. He is currently the CEO of Innovation City, the world’s first free zone fully powered by artificial intelligence (AI) in the UAE, where he is building the Silicon Valley of the Middle East in Ras Al Khaimah. Previously, he was CEO of Holodeck - the leading global media and technology company focused on gaming, esports and web3. His ability to communicate the business opportunity around innovation has made him the largest industry influencer and expert in the MENA region. Paul is the host and creator of Game Changers - a groundbreaking business show on CNBC Arabia reaching 50M homes in the Middle East. He is a frequently requested speaker at tech, startup, web3, and gaming conferences all around the world. He consults family offices, governments, investors, and global companies on startups and building innovation ecosystems. Paul is also the creator of the world's 1st esports NFT and founder of the 2020 fastest growing company in Canada. He believes that the future is fun™. On TV and in media: • My content is consumed daily and trusted by millions in 66 countries around the world, and am widely recognized as the thought leader in the region for startups, tech and gaming. • Host & Creator of “Game Changers” – the most exciting weekly show on CNBC Arabia focused on gaming, esports and the metaverse, reaching 50M homes in the MENA region. • Host & Creator of the world-famous Business of Esports podcast - the largest esports and gaming industry outlet and the only authority on the business side of the gaming/esports industry. Live and in person: • Chairman of the 1st ever Dubai Esports Festival (now called GameExpo) • Invited to speak at the biggest innovation and technology conferences in the world - Next World Forum (KSA), PAX East, Esports Business Summit, World Metaverse Forum, GITEX, SALT, Crypto Bahamas, DIFCFintech Week, World Corporate Summit, Step, LEAP, TMRW, World AI Show, Future Blockchain Summit, RetailME Icons, Fast Company: World Changing Ideas, Dubai Future Forum, Ignite, World Blockchain Summit, Web Summit, AIM Congress, MIT NextTech Summit, etc… • Retained as a startup, web3, AI, gaming, and esports expert by companies, family offices, governments, and investors around the world. • Professor of esports business at Saint Peter's University In books • Author of Metaverse Dream – landmark metaverse book published by Assouline. • Wrote the foreword for the best-selling esports business book of all time (The Book of Esports) • As a VC, I've been talking about gaming, esports and the metaverse since 2011. At work (recent) • Building the Silicon Valley of the Middle East and a global hub for innovation in Ras Al Khaimah • Architect of a world-class gaming investment program for Abu Dhabi (DCT / ADGaming) • Member of the Dubai Program for Gaming Working Group, charting the direction and future of the gaming industry in Dubai • Advisor to Dubai Police on gaming and esports strategies • Consulted as a subject matter expert on the concept & business model for Qiddiya (KSA gaming district) • Consulted with Dubai Health Authority on the metaverse and gamification of healthcare and was recognized by the Director General of DHA • Developed the gaming content strategy for GITEX / Future Blockchain Summit • Expert on building early stage tech, gaming and venture ecosystems

As a consultant, Peter worked on building tech ecosystems, developing country-wide strategies, building new ventures, driving partnerships between private and public sectors as well as digital transformation and restructuring. name: Porter Stowell
title: CEO
bio: Porter Stowell is discoverer of the non-obvious who inspires and unites the brave and the bold to be the pioneers of our digital future. For Porter, there is no better place to pursue this passion than in Web3. It’s an addiction! Porter started his blockchain journey back in 2017 with IBM Blockchain. As a product manager, Porter spent five years working with large enterprises on their blockchain future, leaving as the Head of Product Management. Diving deeper into web3, Porter went on to become the Director of Customer Advocacy at Coinbase where he created engagement approaches for six web3 product lines to ensure global support and scalability. From there, Porter was the Head of Ecosystem and Community for the Filecoin Foundation where he orchestrated the engagement of over 3,000 storage providers, software builders, service providers, investors, and other ecosystem enablers to support the advancement of the Filecoin network and decentralized storage. Today, Porter is the CEO of W3.io; W3 is the operating system for autonomous finance that enables both agents and humans to create any financial workflows for any use case, with any vendor combination. Humans operate at the strategic level, while the platform handles workflow execution, settlement, and management all via a single pane of glass. W3 is driving Web3 adoption beyond the crypto ecochamber solving real problems for real businesses.

bio: Pre-Bitcoin: Graduated M.Tech in Structural Engineering in 2016, from IIT Madras. Worked as a professional Structural Engineer for offshore oil rigs, water treatment plants, bridges, and metro viaducts. 2016-2021. Found Bitcoin in 2017 at the dusk of the Blocksize War. Fell in love with the whole idea and started studying deeper. My journey has been entirely self-taught, where I taught myself the history of money, the principles of Austrian economics, and eventually cryptography and maths. Over time the Bitcoin obsession became so big, that I started learning to code. Eventually, I became good enough to start contributing to Bitcoin FOSS projects. Which landed my first part-time gig at RGB and my first little contributions to Bitcoin Core, in 2020. My journey self-studying at that time I documented in this blog: https://www.citadel21.com/from-hello-world-to-bitcoin-core Left my structural engineering career completely to work on Bitcoiin full-time by being blessed as the first recipient of the Spiral Dev Grant from India, in 2021. Since then my passion for Bitcoin has led me into an ongoing rabbit hole and it has become my life mission to contribute back to the Freedom Industry, in whatever way best I can. Post Bitcoin: Developer Works: Bitcoin Core Contributor: 2020-2021 Developer at RGB: 2020-2021 Developer at BDK: 20021-2023 Lead Dev and PM in Coiinswap: 2023 onwards. Community Works: Cofounded the first Indian Bitcoin-Only Telegram channel: 2018. Organized the first Bitcoin-Only Meetup in Bangalore: 2019. Organized the first Biitcoiin-Only meetup in Goa: 2022. Organized the Technical Track of the first Bitcoin-Only Conference in India: 2022. Educational Works: Mentor at Summer of Bitcoin: Since 2022 Started building Bitshala: 2023. Blogs: https://rajarshi149.medium.com/ Bitshala: At Bitshala we organize a package of educational activities to train the upcoming Bitcoin developers. We offer a roadmap to aspiring developers, reducing the barrier to entry in Bitcoiin FOSS, and finally get them started with a paid Felklowshiip Program to start professional contributions to real Biitcoiin FOSS projects. Find more details here: https://bitshala.org/ My Twitter: https://x.com/RajarshiMaitra Presentation Description: The presentation will be on Bitshala, explaining its objective, mission, and models. I will brief about all the programs we take up at Bitshala. The roadmap to becoming a Bitcoin development, and how people can start getting involved. I will talk a bit about the FOSS Dev mindset, soft-skills required to be a FOSS dev, and tips on selecting FOSS projects to start contributing. The talk concludes with a concrete roadmap for aspiring developers in the room to start taking Bitcoin FOSS as a viable career alternative.

This experience sparked my curiosity as a computer engineer passionate about transformative technology, leading me to explore Bitcoin’s potential. After delving into research and connecting with colleagues, I met a tech-savvy friend who was already mining Bitcoin and coding Ethereum smart contracts, which deepened my interest. As the founders of Miningrid, we created a platform that simplifies Bitcoin mining through a secure, non-custodial wallet, making it accessible to all. name: Simon Dixon
title: CEO & Co-Founder
bio: Simon Dixon has always considered himself a finance geek—obsessed with banking, monetary reform and geo-financial analysis that shape our world. After building a career as an insider in investment banking—as a stockbroker, market maker, and corporate finance banker—he developed a rare understanding of how the financial system really works. But when his father lost everything in the dot-com bust, Simon left his lucrative career behind to become a monetary reformer, determined not just to expose the flaws of finance but to fix them. That mission led him to Bitcoin when it was just $3—a moment that changed everything. Unlike most early adopters who were tech enthusiasts, Simon came from finance, and he decoded what Satoshi left behind: Bitcoin was not just money, but the tool that could end the corrupt financial system, dismantle the Federal Reserve, and strip power from those who abuse it. He saw how politicians and regulators would deliberately co-opt innovation to maintain control—something he experienced first-hand when his attempts to reform the UK banking system were blocked. With that foresight, Simon gained financial freedom through Bitcoin and became one of the earliest investors in the industry’s biggest names—including Coinbase, Kraken, BitPay, Bitfinex, Blockchain.com, Circle and Robinhood. He is also the author of *Bank to the Future* (2012), the world’s first published book to ever discuss Bitcoin. Recognized by Robert Kiyosaki as “the first guy to ever talk about Bitcoin,” praised by Richard Branson for his investment platform BnkToTheFuture.com, and called by Max Keiser “the No.1 Bitcoin investment banker ever,” Simon has long been ahead of his time. Through BnkToTheFuture, he has facilitated over $2.5 billion of investments into companies that shaped the Bitcoin ecosystem. He has helped thousands become Bitcoin millionaires and billionaires—and now seeks to help millions more protect themselves, their families, and their nations from an AI-driven jobless future and the oppressive control of central bank digital currencies (CBDCs)—with Bitcoin as the tool for freedom and protection. Simon is widely recognized not only for his pioneering role in Bitcoin but also for his expertise in geo-financial analysis, money, and investing. His ability to connect Bitcoin, macroeconomics, and global financial power shifts has allowed him to anticipate trends and events years before they unfold—making him the person many influencers and analysts quietly study. Through his weekly show BitcoinHardTalk (100k+ YouTube subscribers, 200k+ followers on X), Simon helps people follow the money, self-custody their Bitcoin, and resist an oppressive financial system whose time is running out.

bio: Policy Director at Exodus, where he leads the company's crypto policy and regulatory strategy. He previously served as Senior Counsel on the House Financial Services Committee's digital assets panel, playing a key role in shaping federal cryptocurrency legislation from 2023 to 2025. Hite brings deep legislative experience and a strategic perspective to advancing sound digital asset policy.

name: Timofey Gordienko
title: Vertical Manager
bio: Over 10 years of experience in Digital & Mobile and 5+ years at TikTok. Oversaw the global rollout of iGaming at TikTok. Managed key projects across iGaming, Gaming, E-commerce, and Big Tech segments.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Tiziana Cannizzaro
title: Head of Marketing & Sales
bio: Tiziana Cannizzaro has worked for over a decade in the iGaming industry, focusing on communication, marketing, and business development. She manages the full customer journey, from identifying new clients and evaluating business opportunities to closing deals and overseeing account management. Since 2017, she has been the Head of Marketing & Sales at Espresso Games, to define commercial strategies and develop new business opportunities. Her approach combines analytical skills with creative insight, shaped by a deep interest in the audiovisual and entertainment industries.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Todd Ault
title: Executive Chairman & CEO
bio: Milton “Todd” Ault, III, is a visionary entrepreneur and seasoned business leader with over 34 years of experience in identifying and cultivating value across diverse financial markets. As the executive chairman and CEO of Ault & Company, a hybrid private equity firm with core operating platforms consisting of AI Data Centers, Infrastructure, Defense, and Capital Markets. Mr. Ault brings a wealth of knowledge and strategic insight to the forefront of business innovation.

name: Tom Emmer
title: U.S. Congressman and House Majority Whip (R-MN)
bio: U.S. Representative serving Minnesota's 6th congressional district since 2015 and current House Majority Whip. Known for his leadership on Bitcoin and blockchain policy in Congress, Emmer champions innovation in financial technology and regulatory clarity for digital assets.

name: Tomas Pérez-Quevedo
title: Co-Founder
bio: Tomás Pérez-Quevedo is the Co- founder of Maka Chain, a layer 1 blockchain that is transforming the payments industry with its innovative model: your token pays our fees. He is also the Co-founder of the Blockchain Factory along with several other successful ventures across different industries over the past two decades
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Tommy Chan
title: Head of DeFi Investment
bio: Tommy is the Head of DeFi Investment at Crypto.com Capital, a $500M venture fund investing in early stage token and equity rounds. There are over 100 projects in Crypto.com Capital's portfolio since inception. Prior to that, he worked at Bank of America covering TMT sector in APAC, with extensive experience in US IPO, HK IPO and M&A.

name: Tony Ashraf
bio: Institutional panel on spot ETFs, tokenized assets, and crypto adoption factors.

name: Tony Ventura
title: Innovation and Technology Speaker
bio: Tony Ventura is a tech influencer, an international speaker and a dedicated technology researcher. He is known for his work in technology and innovation in Brazil, where he created the Digital Transformation course for the Ministry of Economy. He founded the largest digital tools community in Latin America, positively transforming thousands of lives through technology. In addition, Tony established the Brazil Startups association, supporting numerous startups with technology and investments.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Tony Yazbeck
title: Founder
bio: Educator at The Bitcoin Way. Bitcoin Self-Custody • Cybersecurity • Plan B Residencies.

name: Torben Friis
title: Managing Director
bio: Torben Friis is the Managing Director in charge of global distribution at Match Liquidity DMCC. Match is a leading market maker for financial institutions and wholesale clients seeking access to institutional liquidity across capital markets. Torben is a Danish national having started his financial career at Saxo Bank moving on to Asset Management in Switzerland and setting up IG.com in Europe and leading the expansion of activtrades.com to mention a few. Areas of interest are digital assets including central bank digital currencies and what will be the next step for the financial industry as a whole.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Troy Cross
title: Professor of Philosophy and Humanities / Senior Fellow
bio: A Professor of Philosophy and Humanities at Reed College and a Senior Fellow at the Bitcoin Policy Institute (BPI). His decade-long involvement in Bitcoin has focused particularly on examining the environmental impact of Bitcoin mining. Drawing from his previous academic positions at Yale and Merton College, Oxford, he brings valuable expertise in metaphysics and epistemology to discussions of Bitcoin's role in society.

name: Ubair Javaid
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Ubair Javaid is a digital asset, digital ledger technology (DLT), and tokenization expert with a track record of creating innovative digital asset management solutions. As the CEO of Nomyx, he leads a team that is pioneering the democratization of asset tokenization across multiple industries. He has extensive experience in blockchain architecture, compliance for IoT, and data-driven billing platforms for commercial airliners. He previously led developmental efforts for Panasonic Avionics, where he developed solutions that integrated data analytics with Salesforce to optimize complex SLA-driven billing environments. His current focus is on delivering cutting-edge blockchain products that solve critical enterprise challenges.

name: Uliana Soroka
title: Team Lead & Talent Acquisition
bio: Uliana Soroka is a results driven Talent Acquisition Lead with extensive experience in building and scaling high performing recruitment teams. Skilled in developing and executing strategic hiring plans, optimising recruitment processes and using data driven insights to attract and retain top talent across multiple functions and industries. Proficient in full cycle recruitment, including workforce planning, sourcing, interviewing and onboarding. As a team leader, she focuses on mentoring and developing recruiters.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Valentina Diaco
title: Founder
bio: Valentina Diaco is a marketing strategist and growth advisor with nearly two decades of experience across entertainment, luxury, and iGaming. She has led digital for global brands including Bulgari, FOX International Channels, and PlayStation, and has held leadership roles at successful crypto and fiat operators, orchestrating marketing departments across branding, acquisition, and retention , from affiliates to influencers and KOLs. She is the Founder of Profit Matches, a marketing consultancy that helps businesses craft rational, data-driven strategies designed to align profit with purpose, and AI Match, a matchmaking platform that connects iGaming and crypto companies with the right AI solutions to bridge marketing, technology, and growth.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Valentina Gilberti
title: Head of Customer Success & Industry Insights
bio: Valentina Gilberti is the Head of Customer Success and Industry Insights at SGR Compliance, a Swiss company providing a proprietary AML data database. With 14 years in the firm, she has supported database development and technical innovation, maximising data use for compliance, anti-fraud and anti-financial crime initiatives. Her experience highlights a strong focus on accuracy, adaptability and practical risk management in regulatory technology.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Valerij Mitejko
title: Host & Event manager
bio: Valerij Mitejko is an international event host, moderator, and creative producer with over 15 years of experience across Europe. Known for his dynamic stage presence and humour, he has hosted hundreds of weddings, corporate events, and festivals for audiences up to 3,000 people. A finalist of Ukraine’s “League of Laughter” and former TV presenter of “Tourists” on the National Channel, Valerij combines entertainment, emotion, and professionalism in every performance.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Vasilije Lekovic
title: VP Gaming
bio: Payments and fintech specialist with expertise in account-to-account (open banking) and carrier billing payments, user verification (KYC) and identity solutions across different industries (online gambling, social/video gaming, eCommerce) gained in various management and commercial roles. For the last 10 years, Vasilije has been leading the gaming commercial department of Trustly, the global leader in account-to-account payments, as well as various innovative product and business development initiatives, such as the successful rollout of Trustly's flagship Pay N Play product, AgeVerify, NameVerfiy, InBanner and others. Prior to Trustly, Vasilije was in different commercial and business development roles in the information security and telecommunications industries.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Vinícius Moraes De Carvalho
title: Investment Partner
bio: Vinícius has over ten years of experience working as an investor and operator at the intersection of finance and tech. He has been an active venture capital investor at leading funds in Europe and Latin America and holds an MBA from ESADE (Spain).
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Vitaly Balakhonov
title: Brand Growth Engineer
bio: Vitaly Balakhonov, founder and Brand Growth Engineer at GEARRRR.Agency, is a multi disciplinary brand strategist bridging visual, marketing and business crafts. He has orchestrated award winning, industry focused brand activations across major global iGaming shows, including SiGMA, ICE and G2E. Currently, he leads the agency pioneering unconventional growth channels such as organic TikTok, helping iGaming brands command attention and capture markets. He also provides creative advisory for iGaming brands and events.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Vittorio Mele
title: Managing Director
bio: Vittorio Mele started his career in the digital world in one of the largest B2B services groups in the digital pharma industry. He is Managing Director at DT9, a leading company in programmatic and affiliation marketing for the gambling industry in Italy, Europe and Latam, managing all activities from a commercial and operational point of view. Additionally, he manages the DT9 TECH division for the development of internal assets and products to open up to the B2C market.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Vlad Bondarenko
title: Head of Product
bio: Vladyslav Bondarenko leads product development at ReferOn, a next-generation affiliate marketing platform. A major focus for him is automating affiliate program management to minimise manual work and unlock operational scaling. With a background in data-driven product design, Vladyslav has built systems where "laziness" is a feature, not a bug — every process is optimised for speed, simplicity and bulk actions without compromising security or transparency. He believes eliminating unnecessary effort is the fastest path to better results.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Vladimir Malakchi
title: CEO & Managing Partner
bio: Vladimir Malakchi is a strategic investor and scaling specialist with 10+ years’ experience accelerating iGaming businesses to top-tier performance. Named Speaker of the Year, Influencer of the Year and a leading LinkedIn voice, he has guided clients to over 300 industry awards. A respected judge and keynote contributor at international gambling conferences, he founded Xanada Investments in 2024 to finance and unite visionary iGaming projects within a collaborative ecosystem.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Walid Abou Zaki
title: CEO
bio: Walid is the founder of Unlock Blockchain, the MENA region’s leading bilingual platform for blockchain and crypto news. He is a recognized industry voice and frequent moderator of high-level panels, connecting global perspectives with regional opportunities.

name: Warren Davidson
title: U.S. Congressman (R-OH)
bio: U.S. Representative serving Ohio's 8th congressional district since 2016. He is a former Army Ranger and businessman who has become a leading voice on financial technology and cryptocurrency policy in Congress.

name: Weikeng Chen
title: Research Partner
bio: Working on Circle STARK verifier and covenants on Bitcoin

name: William Luther
title: Associate Professor and Graduate Director of Economics
bio: An associate professor and graduate director in the Economics Department at Florida Atlantic University, director of the American Institute for Economic Research's Sound Money Project, and an adjunct scholar with the Cato Institute's Center for Monetary and Financial Alternatives, where his research focuses on currency acceptance and government influence over money. An internationally recognized expert on cryptocurrencies, his work has been cited by major media outlets and published in top academic journals, with the Social Science Research Network ranking him among the top five percent of business authors.

name: Wojciech Trzaska
title: CCO
bio: Wojciech Trzaska is a former asset-manager turned iGaming brand-builder with 20 years’ sector insight. After steering portfolios containing William Hill and bwin, he shifted to operations and now heads strategic communications for sportsbook platform SB Software, championing a “entertainment-first” entertainment ethos. As founder of Vienna consultancy Spectacular, he crafts investor decks and trade-show narratives that win client attention in minutes for gaming and lottery innovators.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Wojtek Sznapka
title: Co-Founder & CEO
bio: Wojtek Sznapka is CEO and Co-Founder of Gamblitude, bringing two decades of tech experience, including 11 years in iGaming, to his leadership role. His passion lies in solving complex industry problems using Big Data and AI. After 11 years working on the operator side, he co-founded Gamblitude to solve the iGaming industry's common data analytics problem by democratising data and using cutting edge cloud technologies and AI. Previously, as CTO at STS Gaming Group, he developed expertise in Data Warehouse design and scalable microservice systems.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Xavier Gomez
title: Group COO
bio: Xavier Gomez is COO of Vancelian, specialising in investment solutions integrating traditional finance and blockchain. He is Founder of MUWPAY, a DeFi platform simplifying multi-token transfers, and Co-founder of INVYO, a data management start-up. Since 2024, he has been a Supervisory Board member at Banque Delubac & Cie, chairing the remuneration and nominations committee. He is also a global fintech speaker, investor, advisor and regular columnist on BFM Business TV.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Xiaohui Liu
title: CEO
bio: Xiaohui Liu is the founder and CEO of OP_CAT Labs, a R&D company focused on OP_CAT technology on Bitcoin. He created sCrypt, a high-level smart contract language for Bitcoin. He also created the CAT protocol, the first miner-validated token standard on Bitcoin using OP_CAT. Before creating sCrypt, he worked as a research scientist at Facebook’s Connectivity Lab. Xiaohui holds a Ph.D. in Computer Science on p2p distributed networking.

company: Consumer Choice Center / Bitcoin Policy Institute
bio: Serves as Deputy Director at the Consumer Choice Center and Fellow at the Bitcoin Policy Institute, where he brings over a decade of experience as a policy analyst, journalist, and consumer advocate across Europe and North America. As a prolific writer, he has published over 1,000 articles in major outlets including USA Today, The Hill, and Chicago Tribune, and previously served as Florida Bureau Chief for Watchdog.org. He holds an MA in Philosophy, Politics, Economics from CEVRO Institute in Prague and brings international perspective through his work between Austria and North Carolina.

He has built a powerful team of BDMs, Account and Sales managers and optimised the work of the commercial department. Led by Yaroslav, the commercial department successfully covers all the requests of 100+ Media buyers and collaborates with more than 500 direct advertisers, resulting in monthly profits of millions of dollars.

With over four years of industry experience, he combines strategic thinking with expertise in partner engagement, communication and negotiation. At ELA Games, he plays a key role in expanding the company’s global presence, building meaningful relationships and driving long-term growth. Before joining, Yaroslav held senior positions at prominent iGaming companies and holds a strong academic background in international relations.
source_category: sigma.world/summits/world/speakers (Central Europe 2025 + SiGMA World Past speakers)

name: Yoni Assia
title: Founder and CEO
bio: Yoni Assia is the Co-Founder and CEO of eToro, the trading and investing platform. Yoni co-founded eToro in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way. Today, the platform has over 40 million registered users from 75 countries and empowers users to trade, invest, share and learn. Yoni showed an interest in finance and computer science from his youth and so decided to merge his passions and his belief in the power of shared knowledge by founding eToro. eToro is a collaborative investment community designed to provide users with the tools they need to grow their knowledge and wealth. Users can hold a range of traditional and innovative assets and choose how to invest: trade directly, invest in a portfolio, or copy other investors. Yoni is widely acknowledged as a crypto pioneer, having co-written the Colored Coins whitepaper with Ethereum creator Vitalik Buterin in 2012. He is also the founder of GoodDollar, the largest, community-driven blockchain UBI project in the world. Yoni is a member of the YPO and was included by Financial News in its Fintech 40 ranking and their Rising Stars in Asset Management ranking. He was also listed in Fortune’s 40 under 40 and in City A.M’s fintech 100 top influencers.

bio: U.S. Representative serving Iowa's 3rd congressional district since 2023, bringing expertise in national security and technology policy to Congress. Prior to Congress, he served as an Iowa State Senator and combat veteran with experience in cybersecurity and intelligence operations. Nunn champions innovation in financial technology and digital assets while advocating for practical regulatory frameworks that promote American competitiveness.

name: Zack Cohen

Since joining BPI in 2023, he has contributed across various departments, including government affairs, research, operations, and development.

bio: Zuby is more than just a rapper. He is an influential public figure, creative entrepreneur, and avid bitcoin supporter. His unique perspective, authenticity, and infectious energy have earned him millions of followers on social media, and millions of downloads of his 'Real Talk with Zuby' podcast. He credits bitcoin with helping him preserve his sovereignty as an independent creator.
